dialogue_messages.content: Since the last infusion I've felt really nauseous and can barely eat. When I stand up I get dizzy.
Have you been able to keep fluids down? Any vomiting, fever, or belly pain? And have you checked your blood sugar?
I can sip water but food makes me gag. No fever, no real pain. I took my metformin but barely ate, my sugar this morning was 4.3.
Is the dizziness worse when you stand, and how much less are you drinking than usual?
Yes, worse when I stand up. I'm drinking maybe half of what I normally do, and I feel weak and a bit lightheaded.

scenario.chief_complaint: Nausea with poor oral intake and orthostatic dizziness
scenario.initial_query: Since the last infusion I've felt really nauseous and can barely eat. When I stand up I get dizzy.

signals_list.summary_text: Mild tachycardia, orthostatic BP drop and glucose drifting low after reduced oral intake on ADC-047.

signals.summary_text: Mild tachycardia, orthostatic BP drop and glucose drifting low after reduced oral intake on ADC-047.

advice: Read as DXd-class GI toxicity converted into a two-front risk by diabetes: volume depletion plus glycemic swings; track both, not just nausea grade
Orthostatic BP/HR, pre/post-meal fingerstick glucose, ketones if hyperglycemic, electrolytes + renal (Na/K/creatinine), intake/output + daily weight
Set an antiemetic plan (5-HT3 +/- dexamethasone) and a metformin-hold rule while intake is poor
IV hydration + glucose management, hold metformin while NPO, treat as >=G2 GI/dehydration AE
Check orthostatic BP/HR and pre/post-meal fingerstick glucose; track fluid intake, urine output and daily weight
Sip fluids frequently and use the antiemetic as prescribed
Urgent contact if you cannot keep fluids down, glucose < 4 mmol/L or > 13.9 with ketones, fainting, or less than 500 mL urine per day

symptoms.chief_complaint: Since the last infusion I've felt really nauseous and can barely eat. When I stand up I get dizzy.
patient_feedback: I can sip water but food makes me gag; dizziness is worse when I stand and I'm drinking about half of usual; morning sugar was 4.3.
raw_patient_feedback: I can sip water but food makes me gag; dizziness is worse when I stand and I'm drinking about half of usual; morning sugar was 4.3.

likely_causes: Drifting hypoglycemia on metformin with poor intake
CNS metastasis, gastroenteritis, hypercalcemia, or anxiety (to exclude)
triage.rationale: Nausea/vomiting is the most common DXd-class AE; in a diabetic, reduced intake on glucose-lowering meds risks hypoglycemia and dehydration shifts glucose unpredictably. Manage proactively before a grade 2-3 dehydration / hypoglycemia event.

onset.en: Persistent nausea with reduced oral intake since the last infusion, with orthostatic dizziness and a low-trending fingerstick glucose.
onset.zh: 自上次输注后出现持续恶心、进食减少,伴体位性头晕及指尖血糖向低值漂移。

symptoms.zh: 轻度心动过速(心率 76 至 96)
血糖向低值漂移(7.0 至 4.3 mmol/L)

escalation.en: A second comparable dehydration-glycemia signal within the metabolic axis triggers a PI safety review plus a protocol-permitted dose hold for that subgroup.
escalation.zh: 代谢轴内出现第二个可比的脱水-血糖信号即触发 PI 安全审查并对该子群启动协议允许的剂量暂停。

intro.en: Emily occupies the GI + metabolic axis, the 2nd of 3 cycle-1 signals across the 8-person cohort and a different organ system from Jason's lung signal. Inference: ADC-047's GI toxicity becomes clinically significant specifically in participants with reduced metabolic reserve (diabetes, frailty, baseline poor intake). Among the 5 asymptomatic, those who are diabetic / older / low BMI are the subgroup most likely to reproduce Emily's dehydration-glycemia pattern.
intro.zh: Emily 占据消化道+代谢轴,是 8 人队列中 3 个第 1 周期信号中的第 2 个,与 Jason 的肺信号属于不同器官系统。推断:ADC-047 的 GI 毒性在代谢储备下降者(糖尿病、虚弱、基线进食差)中尤其具有临床意义。5 名无症状者中,糖尿病 / 年长 / 低 BMI 者是最可能复现 Emily 脱水-血糖模式的子群。

title.zh: 同药受试者易感子群推断

traits.en: reduced pulmonary reserve (metastatic NSCLC, age 72, prior platinum)
traits.zh: 肺储备下降(转移性 NSCLC、72 岁、既往含铂化疗)

organ_toxicity.zh: GI 毒性 + 脱水/血糖失稳

traits.en: type 2 diabetes; reduced metabolic reserve and poor oral intake
traits.zh: 2 型糖尿病;代谢储备下降、进食减少

organ_toxicity.zh: 心脏信号 (LVEF / QTc / 心律)

traits.en: prior CAD, hypertension, low-normal baseline LVEF
traits.zh: 既往冠心病、高血压、基线 LVEF 低限

watch_list.en: For the metabolic-axis subgroup, set pre-emptive antiemetic prophylaxis plus a glucose/intake monitoring plan around the dosing window.
watch_list.zh: 对代谢轴子群,在给药窗前后预先给予止吐预防并制定血糖/进食监测方案。

watch_list.en: Review home glucose logs and renal function before the next dose.
watch_list.zh: 下一剂量前复核家庭血糖记录与肾功能。

inference.en: Early hypovolemia, not yet hemodynamically unstable.
inference.zh: 早期低血容量,尚未血流动力学失稳。

observation.en: Nausea + PO intake ~50% + orthostatic SBP drop + HR 76 to 96
observation.zh: 恶心 + 口服摄入约 50% + 体位性收缩压下降 + 心率 76 至 96

inference.en: Drifting toward hypoglycemia; dizziness is plausibly glycemic and/or orthostatic.
inference.zh: 向低血糖漂移;头晕可能为血糖性和/或体位性。

observation.en: Fingerstick 7.0 to 4.3 on continued metformin with poor intake
observation.zh: 持续服用二甲双胍且进食差时指尖血糖 7.0 至 4.3

inference.zh: 中枢转移(头晕)、感染/胃肠炎、高钙血症、焦虑。

intro.en: Nausea + reduced intake is an expected DXd-class GI signal, but Emily's diabetes converts a 'common nuisance' toxicity into a two-front risk: volume depletion (orthostatic drop, tachycardia) and glycemic swings (metformin + poor intake causing hypoglycemia; dehydration/stress causing hyperglycemia). Track both, not just the nausea grade.
intro.zh: 恶心 + 进食减少是预期内的 DXd 类 GI 信号,但 Emily 的糖尿病将这一'常见小麻烦'毒性变成双线风险:容量不足(体位性下降、心动过速)与血糖波动(二甲双胍 + 进食差导致低血糖;脱水/应激导致高血糖)。两者都要追踪,而非仅看恶心分级。

projection_48_72h.en: Benign course: nausea controlled with antiemetics, intake recovers, glucose stabilizes 6-8, orthostatic resolves.
projection_48_72h.zh: 良性病程:止吐后恶心受控,进食恢复,血糖稳定在 6-8,体位性头晕缓解。

projection_48_72h.en: Progression: unable to keep fluids down, weight/urine output falls, glucose < 4 (or > 13 with ketones if dehydration dominates), syncope.
projection_48_72h.zh: 进展:无法饮水,体重/尿量下降,血糖 < 4(若脱水为主则 > 13 伴酮体),晕厥。

patient.en: Cannot keep fluids down, glucose < 4 mmol/L or > 13.9 with ketones, syncope, or < 500 mL urine/day - urgent contact.
patient.zh: 无法饮水、血糖 < 4 mmol/L 或 > 13.9 伴酮体、晕厥,或每日尿量 < 500 mL — 紧急联系。

physician.en: IV hydration + glucose management, hold metformin while NPO, treat as >=G2 GI/dehydration AE.
physician.zh: 静脉补液 + 血糖管理,禁食期间暂停二甲双胍,按 >=G2 GI/脱水不良事件处理。

surveillance.en: Orthostatic BP/HR, pre/post-meal fingerstick glucose, ketones if hyperglycemic, electrolytes + renal (Na/K/creatinine), intake/output + daily weight.
surveillance.zh: 体位性血压/心率、餐前餐后指尖血糖、高血糖时查酮体、电解质 + 肾功能(Na/K/肌酐)、出入量 + 每日体重。

surveillance.en: Antiemetic plan (5-HT3 +/- dexamethasone) and a metformin-hold rule while intake is poor.
surveillance.zh: 止吐方案(5-HT3 +/- 地塞米松)及进食差期间的二甲双胍暂停规则。

title.en: Projected GI toxicity + dehydration / glycemic instability trajectory
title.zh: 潜在 GI 毒性 + 脱水/血糖失稳轨迹推断

content.en: HER2+ metastatic breast cancer; type 2 diabetes
content.zh: HER2+ 转移性乳腺癌;2 型糖尿病

relevance.en: Diabetes is the reduced-metabolic-reserve trait that turns common GI toxicity into a two-front risk.
relevance.zh: 糖尿病即将常见 GI 毒性转为双线风险的代谢储备下降特征。

content.en: HbA1c 7.2%; baseline renal function on file

relevance.en: Anchors glycemic control and renal baseline for hydration/metformin decisions.
relevance.zh: 为补液/二甲双胍决策锚定血糖控制与肾功能基线。

content.zh: 基线血压 122/80,通常空腹血糖 ~7.0

relevance.en: Makes the 104/68 orthostatic drop and 7.0 to 4.3 glucose drift read as real changes.
relevance.zh: 使 104/68 的体位性下降及 7.0 至 4.3 的血糖漂移可被判读为真实变化。

content.zh: 二甲双胍 1000 mg 每日两次;昂丹司琼 必要时

relevance.en: Metformin on poor intake is the hypoglycemia driver; ondansetron frames the antiemetic plan.
relevance.zh: 进食差时的二甲双胍是低血糖驱动因素;昂丹司琼界定止吐方案。

content.en: prior chemotherapy-induced nausea episodes; 2-day intake decline
content.zh: 既往化疗相关恶心发作;近 2 天进食下降

relevance.en: Establishes the recent 2-day intake decline as the lead-in to current volume depletion.
relevance.zh: 确立近 2 天进食下降为当前容量不足的前置过程。

context_text.en: ADC-047 Phase 1b multi-tumor safety cohort: a small early-phase basket across HER2/EGFR-altered solid tumors. 8 participants are currently on ADC-047; 3 are now symptomatic in cycle 1. Nausea/vomiting is the most common DXd-class adverse event, and drug-induced ILD / pneumonitis is the signature DLT watched for in every participant.
context_text.zh: ADC-047 1b 期多瘤种安全队列:针对 HER2/EGFR 改变实体瘤的早期小型篮式队列。目前 8 名受试者在用 ADC-047,其中 3 名在第 1 周期已出现症状。恶心/呕吐是 DXd 类最常见的不良事件,而药物相关 ILD / 肺炎是需在每位受试者中监测的标志性 DLT。

drug_class.zh: deruxtecan 类 ADC（topoisomerase-I 载荷，DXd 类）
